shared_elements: human figure represented (small seated/kneeling figures in A; a head in B)
frontal/profile depiction of human facial features
justification: A is a flat rectangular panel densely covered with horizontal registers of small script-like signs, with two small kneeling/seated figures facing each other in the lower zone; B is a three-dimensional head in the round with a broad headdress, brow, eyes, nose and cheeks, and no text or registers at all. The only shared content is that human beings are depicted somewhere in each, which is generic; the organising scheme (register-based inscription with miniature figures versus a single sculpted portrait head) is entirely different.
